changes.rationale: Make task-artifact next hand over what to tell each subagent, without adding a gate. Author, review, rewrite and build steps gain a handover text (the page's prompt from docs/ARTIFACTS.md, compiled in and keyed by a new File column, with braces filled from the record's optional prompt object; the exemplar; the output path; the task context; the pages so far; the guide's answering rule on the interview and buy-in; and, for a rewrite, the last review's notes) plus an unfilled list of missing prompt values, whose braces stay visible and which the say names before its own instruction; the exit code is unchanged. The task record gains an optional prompt object (serde(default), deny_unknown_fields, every field Option<String>, checked by next, never by read); schema_version stays 6, and an xtask from before this change refuses a record that has it (one-way compatibility). verdict --notes - reads the reviewer's whole reply from stdin, capped at 64 KiB on bytes before decoding, refusing empty and non-UTF-8 input; any other --notes value is unchanged. The write-ticket stub and COMPLETION.md describe the prompt object; readiness lists seven new tests and handover.rs. Limits: a value wrapped in <...> counts as missing; nothing checks that piped notes are the reviewer's whole reply; renaming docs/ARTIFACTS.md stops xtask from building.
